blocks.text: You can configure Okta single sign-on (SSO) as the authentication method for the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform), allowing users to sign in through your Okta SSO provider, instead of using a username and password. To do this, you can specify a domain, and users with email addresses matching that domain are redirected to authenticate through Okta. Each user must have an account with the same email address in both the Agentic SecOps Platform and in Okta. After SSO is enabled for a domain, it becomes the only authentication method for the Agentic SecOps Platform.
